businesses.business: HVAC and detection and measurement equipment

offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and services heating, cooling and air-handling equipment for contractors, engineers, facility operators and homeowners. Its HVAC lines also include refrigeration, controls and cooling-system water management. It supplies underground locating and inspection equipment, utility robotics, fare collection systems, navigation aids, communications and defense electronics.

quotes.quote: Our HVAC segment offers cooling towers, commercial and industrial refrigeration products, engineered air movement solutions, residential and commercial boilers, and comfort heating systems.
Our Detection & Measurement segment provides specialized underground location and inspection equipment, fare collection systems, aids to navigation, and communication technologies products.

quotes.quote: SPX Cooling Technologies is a leading global manufacturer of cooling towers, fluid coolers, adiabatic cooling systems, evaporative condensers, industrial evaporators and OEM aftermarket parts from brands that include Marley®, Recold® and SGS Refrigeration. our brands’ cooling systems, components and worldwide technical services have supported applications in heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), refrigeration, and industrial process cooling.

SPX Technologies’ Engineered Air Movement (EAM) business is a leading manufacturer of industrial fans, blowers, critical exhaust systems, dampers and other air movement and air control products. Innovative products, from our Cincinnati Fan, Strobic Air Technologies, Tamco and Daniels Fans brands, give operators and engineers superior-quality, energy-efficient options for a variety of applications. We design, manufacture, sell and service these solutions in the commercial, industrial and institutional markets.
